scope: One fresh round: original 95 scenarios plus 20 semantic-v1 cases; report both strata and combined result.
authorship: Assistant source-based review; not independent human gold and not a blind holdout.
freeze: Freeze before new predictions. No production code, prompts, labels, inference configuration, or policy changes during this run.
sampling: Exactly one outer evaluation per scenario; only the existing bounded technical recovery is allowed. No manual grants and no best-of reruns. Original failures count.

metrics.technical_completion: All required source processing nodes completed, processed with no extraction errors. A chain requires both M1 and M2 and no runner exception.
metrics.semantic_correctness_given_completion: Source-reviewed semantically correct complete scenarios divided by all technically complete scenarios; show numerator and denominator.
metrics.end_to_end: Technically complete, semantically correct and required persistence/side effects correct scenarios divided by all scheduled scenarios. Incomplete and semantic failures both count as non-pass.
metrics.automatic_contract: Report existing automatic contract gates separately; parsed/processed/automatic PASS is not semantic correctness.
metrics.unresolved_semantic20: Against frozen semantic-v1 required_unresolved, count retained and missing propositions in the required field, plus unsupported additions; no keyword-only grading.
metrics.usage: All recorded requests, known tokens, unknown-usage requests, local normalization, automatic retries, waiting and exhausted nodes. Never count unknown usage as zero.

review.required: Use current manifest rules, user-policy overlay and semantic-v1 frozen expectations. Equivalent wording and reasonable merge/split are permitted if roles, objects, scope, commitments, dates and final state are preserved.
review.unsupported: Inspect facts, decisions, unresolved, work descriptions, owner/commitment/time, review questions and actual writes against source. A system diagnosis with no business instruction is distinguished from an invented user obligation.
review.collection: A verified unresolved issue with stable collected_issues entry and evidence can satisfy issue collection even when the work branch retains interpretation_unresolved, provided no required real work is lost and no unsupported task or action question is introduced. Apply by source meaning, not by case ID or evidence overlap alone.
review.real_work_unresolved: If an actual required work remains unrepresented or cannot be safely interpreted, record business incomplete even if the technical status is processed; do not excuse it via issue collection.
review.optional: Do not penalize omitted optional content. Added content still requires source support. Formatting or non-obstructive duplication is recorded separately from semantic failure.
review.known_semantic_failures: C11, C24, P08b, CP01, SV15 are evaluated normally, not excluded, automatically failed, or tuned during this run.
review.disputed_labels: Keep the pre-run contract score; record ambiguity and a sensitivity analysis separately. Do not rewrite labels to make current predictions pass.
